functions.description: Draw textured quad via GX registers
functions.notes: ~22 gate runs plus colorsweep (80 compiles, no change). Tried reordering the 0x4a8 expression, locals for sizeS/sizeT/fields 2c/2e, early fmt==2 compare, param types; none reduced the 17 bytes. Remaining: fmt lands in r5 not lr, cmp r,#2 placed after sizeT orr instead of before, and 2e/2c load registers swapped. Source also uses raw volatile register addresses (not via defines), which fails the quality bar even if matched.
